authority_resolution: Current PDR-0011 / AMD-0007 supersedes the global PDR-0007 admission restriction prospectively. No new decision/amendment request.
FRD17/29/31 plus FigJam37: registration without DOB, verify contact, normal Personal Information/DOB, server evaluation, policy-required consent and activation.

FRD18/21 and FigJam47/49/60: independent commercial restrictions under18; existing delegated/sponsored BillingAccount/BillingAuthority handles paid use. No new minor resources or future-plane implementation.
Current privacy/contracts/traceability reuse approved providers, protected purpose-bound retention, shared calendar/effective-policy resolver and owner boundaries.

findings: Do not create a duplicate Account for an existing normalized contact.
Existing Account lookup must resist arbitrary contact enumeration.
Proof must be valid/unexpired; retry and rate limits resolve from policy.
Direct registration does not activate Product relationships or grant Product roles/entitlements.

alignment_required: Replace unnecessary full-name input with required DOB for minimal registration.
Remove unsupported GitHub from the registration slice; federation belongs to TUN-P2-010.
Replace fixed password-composition/length and verification expiry copy with policy-backed presentation.
Verification sent/delivered wording follows actual post-commit evidence.
figma.design_system_discovery: No repository Code Connect files and no instances, variables, text/effect styles in the three reference frames. Preserve the existing editable nodes/fonts; reuse @tunner/ui controls/tokens in code.

implementation_resolution: FRD 17/PDR-0007 fix the 18+ semantics; reuse the evaluator and discard raw DOB after committing derived evidence.

Doc32 expressly permits detailed schemas/OpenAPI during implementation. Use BFF REST/JSON, stable operation identity, server-derived anonymous context, expected versions and safe Problem Details. No Product API or SDK is activated.

Identity owns transactional registration/verification/resend state and canonical Account/contact mutation. Use current EF/Identity stores and shared outbox; do not create a second outbox or canonicalizer.

Required numeric security, hashing, challenge expiry/retry/abuse and privacy/notice values are explicit versioned server policy inputs. Missing or ambiguous policy blocks processing. No screenshot number becomes a security default.

Correct affected Figma flow before flow implementation under Doc31 section1; generated sensitive copy remains a governed proposal until the owning publication/approval workflow supplies effective versions.

No new legal basis, retention period, external identity linking, login session or Product entitlement is invented. Production activation requires the approved processing/retention/security/content configuration; test policy values are explicit fixtures only.

user_sequencing_resolution.request: No DOB on initial terms/privacy screen
user_sequencing_resolution.confirmation: User explicitly selected move DOB to a later eligibility step
authority_pass: FRD17 section11: registration collects DOB and server calculates 18+; no active Account/session/Product relationship for underage.
PDR-0007: DOB-based registration, no separate age checkbox; no first-screen positioning requirement.
FRD31: align affected Figma before flow implementation.
user_sequencing_resolution.implementation: Initial email/password/notices UI, then separate DOB step before POST/canonical processing; consent is not substituted for eligibility.
